risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful quantitative information on customer concentration, sales trends, licensing revenue, debt, liquidity, and forward guidance, but relies substantially on standard risk disclaimers and conditional language. Key risks include customer concentration, inflation and supply-chain costs, COVID-19 disruption, intellectual-property matters, and uncertainty around demand normalization. Liquidity appears adequate and management expresses confidence in funding operations for at least the next 12 months.
